name: Campingplatz im Kaunertal
beschreibung: The campsite in Kaunertal is situated at an altitude of around 1,400 metres in the middle of Naturpark Kaunergrat. Its location near the Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße makes it a popular starting point for active holidaymakers. The facilities include modern sanitary amenities, electricity connections, and separate pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. In summer, countless hiking and mountain biking tours start directly from the site, while in winter the ski area on the glacier is easily accessible. The quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere and family-run operation appeal to a broad audience, from nature lovers to families. A small shop and a restaurant on the grounds complete the offering for a stay close to nature.
